sources.title: Forterra Bison precast hollowcore and solid floors
sources.usedFor: 200 mm hollowcore comparison; 75 mm nominal steel bearing, 100 mm nominal masonry bearing; grouted longitudinal joints. Shared narrow masonry bearings and shelf details need additional designed closure/ties. Product load-span examples exclude additional masonry, concentrated loads and holes: they are not the house design.

sources.title: Hollowcore camber details, 20 November 2017
sources.usedFor: L/300 guide only. Prestress, age and unit length affect camber; it is not a maximum production or installation tolerance. The 20 mm budget is an authored allowance requiring actual supplier acceptance.

sources.title: MPA Precast Supporting Steelwork, August 2024
sources.usedFor: Installation can twist steel under one-sided units before joints cure. Erection restraint, support and prop positions must be designed; nominal floor bearing is not beam stability.

sources.title: Precast concrete floors in steel framed buildings, June 2018
sources.usedFor: Separate slab, support, diaphragm/tie, erection and beam design duties. Noncomposite beam and grouted-joint assumptions require their own actual details.

sources.title: Approved Document K, England, 2013 edition, section 1 and Table 1.1
sources.usedFor: Private-stair comparison only: rise 150..220 mm, going 220..300 mm, pitch at most 42 degrees and normal 2R+G 550..700 mm. This does not check landings, headroom, guarding, fire strategy or the complete stair.

authoredAssumptions: S275 with E 210000 MPa for elastic screening; actual grade, class, restraint and member resistance are unqualified.
G 1.35 and Q 1.5 are the explicit gravity challenge factors, not a complete project action combination schedule.
Floor G 3.1 + 2.1 kN/m2, Q 2 kN/m2; heavy masonry is added separately, never hidden in a generic partition allowance.
Gross masonry 22 kN/m3 and plaster 20 kN/m3; openings earn no relief. Default 27 mm each-side finish is a comparison, not the admitted installed finish for every wall.
Roof G 3 and Q 1.5 kN/m2 are retained source action budgets, not actual roof mass, wind, snow or inherited reactions.
The stair 15 kN permanent plus 5 kN variable midspan point and front/bath tributary widths are authored challenges, not a complete load take-off.
L/360 is an authored beam deflection screen. It does not qualify brittle finishes, vibration or differential precast camber.
The 25 mm side fire envelope, 70 mm soffit reserve, 10 mm bed, 25 mm setting reserve and 80 mm finish depth are spatial allowances, not specified approved assemblies.
The 300 x 140 mm padstone area only reports demand. Padstone strength, spread, eccentricity, adjacent openings and combined bearing forces are unresolved.
